description: This file defines the RemotePortTunnel class which manages SSH port forwarding tunnels in a macOS environment. It includes methods for creating, managing, and cleaning up SSH tunnels, handling external dependencies like Network, Process, and OSLog, and configuring tunnel parameters such as remote and local ports. The class is designed for remote port forwarding using SSH in a macOS application.
external_methods: Inet socket functions: bind(), setsockopt(), inet_pton()

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A class managing SSH port forwarding tunnels for remote mode, facilitating creation, termination, and cleanup of SSH tunnels.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts a new SSH port forwarding tunnel with specified remote and local port options.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH tunnel and cleans up associated resources.
